content_metadata.description: A video covering a camping and fishing trip on Fish Lake Island in Hiawatha National Forest, Michigan. The video includes an unexpected storm and a promotion for the creators' new merchandise store.

qAndA.answer: She caught a sunfish (you can tell by the distinctive shape and markings of the fish).

qAndA.answer: They used fast cuts, shaky camera work, strong wind noises, and shots of heavy rain and dark skies.
qAndA.question: How did the creators demonstrate the intensity of the storm in the video?

youtube_description:
After days catching panfish, bass, and pike on the lake, and nights eating delicious food by the fire... The storm rolls in on our adventurers. Join them on Fish Lake Island in the Hiawatha National Forest in Michigan's Upper Peninsula as they ride out the wind and rain together with just a tarp for protection. Theres nowhere to hide from the lightning, so its time to crack a cold one and enjoy the show... 
But after the storm clouds clear, and the sunshine starts drying the island out, Kara puts her dogcam on for a walk around the island and a much deserved dip in the cool refreshing waters of Fish Lake with her favorite people in the whole wide world. 

Thanks for watching! Please remember to give this video a thumbs up and SUBSCRIBE to our channel then click the bell so you'll get a notification next week when Jon and Drew hit the lake for one last island adventure in search of the elusive Michigan Northern Pike.
